passages.source_text:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात् पूर्णमुदच्यते।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
passages.transcription_status: Institutional display directly checked; not a new critical edition.
passages.textual_note: Source-script wording and punctuation follow the Vedic Heritage Portal invocation. IAST spacing resolves word boundaries. The same two principal lines occur at Bṛhadāraṇyaka 5.1.1 in the held GRETIL witness; that is a separate locus.

सत्यपि भेदापगमे नाथ तवाहं न मामकीनस्त्वम् ।
सामुद्रो हि तरङ्गः क्वचन समुद्रो न तारङ्गः ॥ ३॥

passages.source_text: सदात्मना सर्वव्यवहाराणां सर्वविकाराणां च सत्यत्वं सतोऽन्यत्वे च अनृतत्वमिति

passages.textual_note: This packet follows the institutional reading sato ’nyatve ca anṛtatvam. The held GRETIL witness instead reads sato ’nyatvenānṛtatvam, with an instrumental. The two witnesses are not silently blended; both express the contrast between reality as Being and untruth in separation/otherness.
